title: TRUEGRADEAI: RETRIEVAL-AUGMENTED AND BIAS-RESISTANT AI FOR TRANSPARENT AND EXPLAINABLE DIGITAL ASSESSMENTS
reasoning: The paper focuses on an AI-driven digital examination framework for grading. While it uses a religious history question as a primary example (Sufism), the core research is about the grading technology (OCR, RAG, and LLM evaluation) rather than benchmarking or evaluating religion, faith, or ethics.
